propositions.proposition: 根据行业类型、地域风险和交易行为将客户风险分为低、中、高三级
source_quotes: Customers may be assessed for risk and assigned low-, medium-, or high-risk status based on industry type, jurisdictional exposure, and transaction behaviors.

basis_or_condition: 基于行业类型、地域风险和交易行为

outcomes_or_paths: 更精细的风险为本方法应用

propositions.proposition: 高风险客户需强化尽职调查，标准风险客户（含低、中风险）也需进行尽职调查
source_quotes: Customers deemed high risk are typically examined more deeply through enhanced due diligence. Customers deemed standard risk, which includes low and medium risk, also undergo a due diligence process.
